title: Correct Expression for n(E)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for n(E) in terms of the relevant variables.

title: Limit Condition Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the condition d >> lambda and relate it to the classical distribution.

title: Average Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the average energy difference correctly for both systems.

title: Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student should appropriately use and define all relevant variables such as mass, temperature, and chemical potential.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the expressions for energy and chemical potential.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or alternative approaches to reinforce understanding.
